items.title: 7.7 Nataij aur faislon ka abalagh (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Nataij aur nateeje (conclusions) batana data analysis aur research ka aham qadam hai. Is se parhne wale samajhte hain ke data kya dikhata hai aur kaun se faisle kiye ja sakte hain. Wazeh tareeqe se batane se nataij ki ghalat-fehmi ya ghalat istemal nahi hota. Researchers ko nataij saade aur mantiqi andaz mein samjhane chahiye. Nateeje sirf analyze kiye gaye data par mabni hon. Achhi communication transparency aur saakh barhati hai, aur achhi reporting aage ki research aur faislon mein bhi madad deti hai.
Test ke nataij ka matlab samajhna (interpretation)

Test ke nataij interpret karne ka matlab hai samajhna ke statistics ke nateejon ka kya matlab hai. Is mein p-values, confidence levels ya test statistics jaisi qeematon ka analysis shamil hai. Nataij se tay hota hai ke hypothesis accept hota hai ya reject. Researchers ko nataij samajhte waqt data ka context (pas-e-manzar) zaroor dekhna chahiye. Ghalat tashreeh ghalat nateejon tak le jati hai. Durusti ke liye nataij ki wazeh tashreeh zaroori hai, aur sahi interpretation qabil-e-bharosa aur ba-maani nataij deti hai.
Nataij wazeh tareeqe se pesh karna

Nataij wazeh pesh karne se parhne wale research ke nataij aasani se samajhte hain. Nataij mantiqi aur munazzam (structured) tareeqe se tarteeb diye jayein. Wazahat ke liye tables, charts aur graphs use kiye ja sakte hain. Technical jargon (mushkil takneeki alfaaz) ki jagah saadi zaban use ho. Aham nukaat numayan kiye jayein. Wazeh pesh-kash uljhan kam aur baat-cheet behtar karti hai, aur research ko zyada mufeed banati hai.

Nateeje seedha asal hypotheses se jure hone chahiye. Researchers saaf batayein ke hypothesis ki tayeed (support) hui ya nahi. Data aur test ke nataij nateeje ko sahi sabit karein. Zaati raaye aakhri nateeje par asar na dale. Wazeh rabt research ki validity (sehat) mazboot karta hai, study mein mantiqi tasalsul laata hai, aur research ka process mukammal karta hai.

blocks.title: Misaal: 7.4 wale test ki report
blocks.text: 7.4 ki misal ki wazeh report yeh kahegi: 'Humne jaancha ke kya naya tareeqa-e-tadrees number pichhle average 70 se oopar le jata hai. Is tareeqe se parhe das talaba ka average 77 (standard deviation 2.79) tha. One-tailed t-test ne t = 7.93 diya aur p 0.05 se bohat kam tha, is liye hum null hypothesis radd karte hain: tareeqa number behtar karta lagta hai. Namoona chhota aur be-tarteeb nahi chuna gaya tha, is liye bari tehqeeq ki sifarish hai.'

blocks.prompt: Report mein tehqeeq ki hudood, jaise chhota namoona, kyun batani chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Taake parhne wale nateeje par saboot se zyada bharosa na karein: chhota ya ghair-numainda namoona poori population ki akkasi nahi kar sakta, aur yeh batana abalagh ko imandar rakhta aur aage ki research ki rehnumai karta hai.

items: Nataij context ke saath samjhein; mubaligha na karein.
Tables, charts aur saadi zaban se nataij wazeh karein.
Har nateeja apne hypothesis se, saboot ke saath, jorein.
